phase: Phase 1 - Dataset Validation and ML Model Training

metrics.imbalance_explanation: The test dataset is severely imbalanced (565 non-exoplanets vs 5 confirmed exoplanets, representing ~99.12% vs ~0.88%). A naive majority-class classifier that blindly predicts class 1 for all samples achieves an accuracy of 99.12%, yet completely fails to detect a single exoplanet (0% recall on class 2). Therefore, accuracy alone is misleading; recall and F1-score for the positive minority class (class 2) are the primary indicators of transit detection efficacy.
metrics.domain_interpretation_disclaimer: TransitHunter AI predicts the classes represented by its training dataset labels (1: non-exoplanet, 2: confirmed exoplanet). A positive prediction indicates statistical similarity to confirmed Kepler transit flux patterns, but does not constitute physical or astronomical proof that an unknown star hosts an exoplanet.
